svg.aria-label: Left: fraction of a cell value that survives k steps for forget-gate biases -3, 0, 1 and 3. Right: measured size of the gradient of the last hidden state with respect to earlier inputs at initialisation; the plain RNN, default GRU and zero-bias LSTM fall by about 20 orders of magnitude over 100 steps, while the LSTM with forget bias 3 stays near 1
